title: orchis traunsteineri subsp. ochroleuca
intro: Orchis traunsteineri subsp. ochroleuca, commonly known as the Yellow-green Man Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Orchis traunsteineri subsp. ochroleuca include its ability to stimulate blood circulation, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
